statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let low := fun (n k : ℕ) => if k^3≤n then w k else 0; let high := fun (n k : ℕ) => w k-low n k; let L := fun n : ℕ => max 1 (Nat.log 2 n / 2); let K := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (L n), Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(2:ℝ)^(j+1)*t))/(L n:ℝ); let B := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | t ∉ arcs n ∧ (1:ℝ)/2 < K n t}; let W := fun (n : ℕ) (p : ℕ → Prop) => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ (Q n)^2 ∧ a ≤ q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ p q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ ((Q n:ℝ)^2)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let F := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => ‖S n (high n) t‖^2; let T := fun n : ℕ => (n:ℝ)*(1+Real.log (n:ℝ))^4; let m := fun (s : Set ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) => intervalIntegral (s.indicator f) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, Even n → ∀ j : ℕ, L n / 16 ≤ j → j < Nat.log 2 n + 3 → let y := (2:ℝ)^j*T n; y * m ((B n \ (W n (fun _ => True))) ∩ {t : ℝ | y < F n t ∧ F n t ≤ 2*y}) (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) ≤ (n:ℝ)/(100000*(1+Real.log (n:ℝ))^2)

plain_statement.zh: 只控制能消耗预算的深次弧峰高层
plain_statement.en: Bound only the deep-minor height bins that can consume the budget

brief.zh: 只估计 ⌊L/16⌋≤j<⌊log₂ n⌋+3 的层，门槛 y=2ʲn(1+log n)⁴ 为平方振幅。可研究超过门槛的大值点间距，或寻找使单层过密的共振结构。下方所有层的能量之和已有 o(n) 界，上方各层为空。
brief.en: For squared amplitude y=2ʲn(1+log n)⁴, estimate only floor(L/16)≤j<floor(log₂ n)+3. Study spacing of large values, or look for structures that overfill a bin. All lower levels together cost o(n); higher bins are empty.
